title: SinettiRecourseExtensionParams
description: params for the Sinetti recourse A2A agent-card extension (https://rep.sinetti.ai/ext/sinetti-recourse/v1). These values are self-asserted by whoever publishes the agent card. A consumer MUST fetch `card` and compare `wallet` before relying on `observed`.

wallet.description: The settlement address this agent trades from. The subject of the reputation card.

card.description: Authoritative, operator-computed reputation card for `wallet`. Public and unauthenticated; returns a thin card to anonymous callers.

cardSchema.description: JSON Schema the full card validates against.

escrows.description: CAIP-10 identifiers of the Sinetti escrow deployments whose settled events feed this card. A deal settled anywhere else is not in it.

observed.description: A stale-able hint, copied from the card at the time the agent card was written. Never a substitute for reading `card`. Null when the wallet has no settled Sinetti history.
